top_signals.title: Samsara makes AI agent platform generally available, reports 7x adoption growth
top_signals.summary:
Samsara has made its no-code Agent Studio platform generally available, allowing customers to build AI agents for tasks such as driver compliance monitoring, operational reporting and driver communication. The company says usage has grown rapidly, though customer adoption and financial returns remain unclear.

top_signals.summary: Allan Gray Ltd., which oversees $29 billion in assets, favors Nigerian stocks over South Korean equities, as they offer a diversification play from the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has swept markets from Wall Street to Asia.

top_signals.title: Italy Industry Lobby Says Energy Shock Could Wipe Out Growth
top_signals.summary: A worsening energy shock could wipe out Italy’s economic growth next year, with high power prices and European Union carbon costs hurting industrial competitiveness, according to the country’s largest business lobby.

top_signals.title: Princeton Researchers Find a Lower-Energy Route to Fusion Ignition
top_signals.summary: A new model for nuclear fusion has potentially discovered a significantly more energy-efficient way to achieve nuclear fusion, and flipped everything we thought we knew about the fusion process. The scientists’ modelling also flips the traditional order of operations for managing and sustaining plasma in a controlled fusion experiment. Traditionally, fusion processes start by compressing plasma for higher density, and then heating it to superhot temperatures.
